# Pray Without Ceasing (1 Thessalonians 5:17)

## Emotional Focus
The joy of talking and listening to God every day.

## Key KJV
“Pray without ceasing.” (1 Thessalonians 5:17)

## Gentle Retelling
The Bible says we can talk to God all the time — in the morning, at meals, when we play, and at bedtime. He is always near.

## Coloring Prompt
A happy child walking through the day with Jesus, talking and listening in every scene.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You can talk to God all day long — He is your very best Friend.”
